# exo_m365_cross_tenant_access_policy (Data Source)

Look up an existing M365CrossTenantAccessPolicy object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `authorization_policy` (String) Maps to the -AuthorizationPolicy parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `object_id` (String) Maps to the -ObjectId parameter.
